label: Mattes
description: Transition shapes: wipes, irises, brush and ink reveals.

items.name: Diagonal wipe panel
items.description: A slanted panel 1.5 frames wide (#panel). Size it width:150%; height:100%, start it fully left of the frame (translateX(-100%)) and sweep to translateX(100%) over 0.5-0.7s; swap scenes at the midpoint when it covers the frame.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Circle iris
items.description: Circle (#circle) large enough to cover the frame from the center. Scale it from 0 (iris open over the cut) or from 1 to 0 (iris close); move transform-origin to open from the subject.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Brush stroke wipe
items.description: Ragged painted band (#stroke) wider than the frame. Sweep it across (translateX -100% to 100%) for a hand-made paint wipe; as a mask it reveals the next scene with brushed edges.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Ink splash
items.description: Central ink splat with droplets (#splat, .drop). Scale #splat from 0 to 2.2 from the center over 0.5s to cover the frame, then reveal the next scene; drops trail 0.05s behind.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Liquid wave rise
items.description: Panel with a wavy top edge (#wave), 1400 tall. Rise it from below the frame (translateY(100%) to translateY(-23%)) to flood the screen; the wave edge leads.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Vertical stripes wipe
items.description: Eight full-height bars (#bar-1..8, .bar). Grow them with scaleY 0 to 1 (transform-origin top or bottom), staggered 0.04s left to right, cut, then retract the other way.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Camera shutter blades
items.description: Six aperture blades (#blade-1..6) that close to the center. Rotate each blade about the frame center (transform-origin 960px 540px) from 60 degrees open to 0 to close, then reverse to open on the next scene.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Zigzag tear panel
items.description: Panel with a sharp zigzag leading edge on the right (#panel). Sweep it left to right across the frame.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Grid tiles transition
items.description: 8x5 tiles (.tile, #tile-1..40, 240x216 each). Scale tiles 0 to 1 from their centers, staggered diagonally (grid stagger, from the top-left), to tile over the cut; reverse to reveal.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Glitch slices
items.description: Twelve horizontal slices of varied height (.slice, #slice-1..12). Flash them over the cut for 3-6 frames, offsetting each slice's x by a seeded amount per frame (stepped ease), then cut clean.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Chevron push
items.description: Giant right-pointing chevron panel (#panel). Push it left to right across the frame: a 'forward/next' transition that obeys a rightward current.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Torn paper panel
items.description: Paper panel (--paper) with a torn right edge and a lighter fiber lip (#paper, #lip). Slide it across for a collage-style rip transition; pair with paper-fibers overlay.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Star zoom-through
items.description: Five-point star (#star) centered. Scale it from 0 to 9 from the center to punch through to the next scene; for a playful, high-energy cut.
items.license: original work generated by the harness (scripts/creative-assets); free to use

items.name: Split halves
items.description: Two diagonal halves (#half-a, #half-b) that close over the frame like doors. Slide #half-a in from the left and #half-b from the right; reverse to open on the next scene.
